macro.overnight_read: Major indices show a pre-market relief gap (QQQ +1.24%, SPY +0.48%), but with 10-year Treasury yields at 5.1%, breadth weak at 30% above the 50-day average, and the SPY put/call ratio at 1.96, index rallies remain vulnerable to intraday selling.
macro.summary: The market is undergoing a aggressive rotation away from growth into defensive assets and energy, pressured by a 10-year yield holding above 5.1%. While tech is seeing an oversold morning gap up, weak underlying breadth and crowded long futures positioning make index bounces high-risk to chase. We are prioritizing long momentum in Energy and Consumer Staples while actively scouting short entries on failing rallies in semiconductors. Risk is managed tightly with quick profit taking ahead of next week's heavy macro slate and FOMC meeting.
